risk_notes.message: Baseline uses users.created_at instead of confirmed first-paid date.
Baseline sums gross amount and misses refund/discount columns.

system_sql_panel.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', users.first_paid_at) AS month, SUM(payments.amount - payments.refund_amount - payments.discount_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM users
JOIN payments ON users.user_id = payments.user_id
WHERE users.first_paid_at >= {start_date}
  AND users.first_paid_at < {end_date}
  AND payments.status = 'PAID'
GROUP BY 1
